correctness.rationale: Grouping powers S^k by k mod n gives W_H=C(b) D_H C(b)^T, with d0>...>d(n−1)>0 for H≥n. The isospectral matrix D_H^1/2 C^TC D_H^1/2 has fixed diagonal d and Ky Fan gives majorization. Equality of tr(B²) forces all off-diagonal cyclic correlations to zero. Hadamard gives exact determinant optimum; a vector perpendicular to first n−1 shifted columns yields λmin≤d_last with rigid equality; dual column Cauchy–Schwarz gives inverse-trace optimum; two Rayleigh bounds give the condition number optimum; Fourier moduli one characterize all real signed orthogonal circulant shifts, nonnegative solutions are point masses. Independent exact rational calculations on n=2,3,4, damping 1/2 or 3/4 and H=n,n+3,3n checked 42 factorization/determinant/trace cases; finite checks only corroborate universal algebraic argument.
